Marta (People Ops): quick heads-up: Santos submitted resignation, last day 2026-09-15. International visa support needed + HSA rollover question. Priya can you own device and SSO timing?
Santos (Data Eng): thanks team. Last day confirmed. yes please send COBRA/HSA docs to santos.personal@mail.com. For laptop I prefer prepaid label. Also need a letter for immigration re: last day.
Priya (IT): opening IT ticket IT-13001. Options: ship prepaid FedEx label or drop at London desk. We'll schedule deprovision for 2026-09-15 17:00 BST (after EOD).
Nora (Comp): equity/comp: RSU proration will be calculated and emailed by 9/20; final pay runs on next payroll cycle. HSA: account is portable; People Ops will include transfer instructions.
Diego (Legal): will draft the immigration confirmation letter and include dates/access termination language. Also reminder: post-employment IP/NDA still applies.
Alex (Security): please list services Santos has admin on (AWS, GCP projects, Databricks). We'll rotate related keys after handoff. On last day we'll revoke Okta and disable VPN certs.
Santos (Data Eng): I'll DM a quick inventory of service accounts and repos tonight.
Marta (People Ops): COBRA packet and HSA transfer docs go out 2026-09-16. Visa letter out 2026-09-16 as well. Please ensure any export-controlled dataset access is closed before deprovision.
Oncall Bot: reminder queued: remove Santos from PagerDuty and team channels at 17:05 BST on 2026-09-15.
Priya (IT): sample deprovision steps (internal):
```
# suspend okta
oktactl update user santos@redwood.ai suspended true
# remove ssh
ssh-keygen -f /home/santos/.ssh/authorized_keys -R santos
```
Alex (Security): I'll run a quick token audit after Santos shares the inventory; we'll rotate any exposed tokens.
Nora (Comp): final note: submit expense reports within 30 days to be included in final payout.
Marta (People Ops): closing loop: People Ops sends COBRA/HSA + visa letter 9/16, IT deprovisions 9/15 17:00 BST, security rotates keys after audit, comp to send payout calc. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
